works.body:
Thank you for your kind words! Your style is adorable, I'd love to take you up on your offer.

If you are still willing, I would love to see my OC, Delta, in your style.

Delta is a sweet, kind person who appears carefree on the surface, but always seems to know a lot more than people expect. He is someone who either knows, or has, an important secret to keep.

His design motifs include butterflies, bioluminescent seas, and the night sky/stars.

The artwork labeled with a "0" is his most up to date version of his main design. 
He also has an alternative outfit.
You are free to simplify whatever design you use as needed.
Alternatively, you're free to dress him in something of your own creation, if you prefer!

I'm happy to leave everything to your discretion! I trust your judgement.
You are free to decline for any reason.

Thank you for the opportunity!
I hope you have a lovely day!
